description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called SettingsFragment, which constructs a settings screen for an app. It includes UI components for profile, favorites, language selection, shortcuts, about, subscription, and logout functionalities. The widget uses shared preferences for language preferences and navigates to other screens such as LanguageScreen and OTPValidationScreen.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the settings screen, providing options for user profile, favorites, language selection, shortcuts, about information, subscription, and logout.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the settings screen, including sections for general and other settings, and handles navigation and logout confirmation.

methods.name: _buildSettingsItem
methods.description: Creates a card-styled ListTile for a settings option, with icon, title, optional subtitle, trailing widget, and onTap handler.

methods.name: _showLogoutDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to log out, clears preferences on confirmation, and navigates to OTPValidationScreen.

search-terms: navigation to language and OTP screens
